mapper.select: SELECT r.report_id, r.report_content, r.created_at, r.is_processed, r.is_processed_time, r.poster_id, r.report_target_post_id, r.report_target_user_id, r.comment_id, r.violation_id, reporter.nickname AS reporter_nickname, target.nickname AS reported_nickname FROM tbl_report r INNER JOIN tbl_user reporter ON r.poster_id = reporter.user_id INNER JOIN tbl_user target ON r.report_target_user_id = target.user_id WHERE r.is_processed = 'Y'
